quests.title: The Road to Crownhaven
quests.summary: Your journey begins. Say goodbye to home and find the royal researcher.

steps.text: Talk to Briony at home, then take the east road.
Follow the Mossway east to Crownhaven.
Find Professor Elias inside the Royal Workshop.

quests.title: Smoke Over Oakvale
quests.summary: Enemy soldiers took Professor Elias and burned Oakvale as a distraction.

steps.text: Make your way to Oakvale and see what is left.
Stand with the General and the Warrior against the enemy rear guard.
Speak with the General once the smoke clears.

quests.title: Grow Stronger
quests.summary: Placeholder: the General and the Warrior are preparing for war. Grow stronger, for your mother's sake, and explore.

quests.title: Trouble on the Mossway
quests.summary: Cutpurses hold the plank bridge over the brook.

steps.text: Cross the plank bridge on the Mossway.
Beat the footpad and Cutpurse Nell.

quests.title: A Fellow Tester
quests.summary: Lark, another first-batch tester, wants to measure herself against you.

steps.text: Look for Lark just inside Crownhaven's south gate.
Win or lose, finish your first duel with Lark.

quests.title: The Crown Cup
quests.summary: Four bouts, weakest first, ending against Champion Isolde.

steps.text: Enter the cup with Arena Master Bex at the Crownhaven arena.
Win every bout, finishing against Champion Isolde.
